scope: Every Bastion armor model has red, blue and green variants. Very-light protection uses colored protective textile. Shared unchanged head.

entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE COLOR VARIANT of supplied Project RL Bastion armor BODY MODULE BA-W01-P01-r01. The image is the exact EDIT TARGET, not inspiration for another design. Change ONLY protective armor paint/pigment to matte crimson red, scarlet lit planes and burgundy shadow planes, all one red hue; no orange accents. On this VERY LIGHT outfit, recolor the PALE REINFORCED PROTECTIVE VEST and its orange edging/fastenings, and pale protective toe caps. The vest is protective textile rather than rigid plates. Keep ordinary charcoal/olive trousers, dark wrist wraps, black glove leather, dark boots, their laces and ALL EXPOSED HUMAN SKIN unchanged. Monochromatic means a single hue for all recolored protection, with that hue's light and shadow values preserving volume. No ivory/orange secondary paint accents left on those protected areas. Preserve EXACT original silhouette, anatomy, pose, all garment and armor geometry, all seams, wrinkles, surface finish, highlights and shadows, both empty hands, finger positions, boot positions and image framing. No redesign, no new armor plate, no extra limb, no added detail, no new texture. Keep the same matte hand-painted 2D game sprite style. Neck skin must remain natural warm human skin; bare arms/fingers must NOT turn the paint color. This is a HEADLESS neck-to-boots BODY COMPONENT: do not add any head, hair, face, implant, helmet, mask or headband; a fixed unchanged head is assembled separately. Preserve clean transparent alpha to the contour, no background, ground, cast shadow, checkerboard, labels, text, grid, glow, haze or new accessories. One complete body component only, both boots inside canvas. Final display is 64x64; retain the original style and construction while changing only the material hue.
